faults.title: Clogged diesel particulate filter (Mk5)
faults.description: On the 2009-2017 Mk5 Polo, the exhaust particulate filter on diesels can block up if the car mostly does short, low-mileage trips. Auto Express suggests a petrol if you don't cover many miles.

faults.title: Heat-damaged headlight lenses (Mk5)
faults.description: Some Mk5 owners have found the headlight lenses damaged by heat from the daytime running lights being left on for long periods. Inspect the lenses closely.

faults.title: Fast-wearing or warped brake discs (Mk5)
faults.description: Auto Express reports some Mk5 Polos wear through brake discs quickly. Feel for juddering through the pedal or steering when braking, which points to warped or worn discs.

faults.title: Fuel filter and seat recalls (Mk5)
faults.description: The Mk5 had five recalls, including a December 2014 campaign for a cracked filter that could leak fuel and an August 2015 one for front seats that could fail in a crash. The 1.6 TDI was also part of the VW diesel emissions recall.
